name: @builderforce/read-through-cache
description: The canonical read-through cache — L1 in-isolate Map + L2 Workers KV — written ONCE. Shared by the API (every read-heavy path, every writer's invalidation) and the legacy worker (which caches the API's session-introspection verdict in the API's OWN KV namespace, so an API-side revoke deletes the key the worker reads). Dependency-free: the KV binding is passed per call, error reporting and delete-retry are injected, and the 512-byte key hashing carries its own WebCrypto SHA-256. Source-only: every consumer aliases the bare specifier straight at src/index.ts.
